fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-01-05, an older model smartphone of the complainant went missing after a brief push in a crowded stretch at Amudham Garden Market Road. The time of the incident was given as 10:45 on 2025-01-05. Thirumal Babu reported the matter orally at Salem East PS; the contact number given was 9000000321. Vignesh Subramani (mobile 9000000487) was named as a possible person of interest. The complainant noted the registration number TN-47-ZZ-1038 of a maroon motorcycle. Meena Sekar (9000000196) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and a call detail reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly approached from behind and took the phone before leaving the spot.
fields.Keywords: mobile theft, smartphone, witness, mobile number, morning, motorcycle, call detail, CCTV
